scene:
Two zones read left to right, plus one strip along the bottom.

LEFT ZONE (about half the width), a matching table of four rows. Each row has a gap on the left, a teal arrow pointing right, and the matching help on the right; each item has one simple icon above its label.
Row 1: a padlocked folder, labelled DECISION STUCK → a small board table with chairs, labelled BOARD OVERSIGHT.
Row 2: a question mark inside a head silhouette, labelled NEW KIND OF JUDGMENT → one person with a speech bubble containing a lightbulb, labelled OPERATING ADVISER.
Row 3: a single rare key, labelled SCARCE SKILL → three small figures holding tools, labelled SHARED SPECIALISTS.
Row 4: an overflowing in-tray with a clock, labelled NO TIME TO EXECUTE → a person with a hard hat working inside an office outline, labelled DEDICATED EXECUTION.

RIGHT ZONE, a horizontal timeline of a pilot, drawn as two parallel bars starting at the same left point: a short ochre bar labelled SPECIALIST 6 WEEKS, and a bar twice as long in teal labelled PROGRAM LEADER 12 WEEKS. At the end of the short bar a vertical dashed line down to a milestone with a funnel icon narrowing to two small customer figures, labelled WEEK 6: NARROW TO 2 VOLUNTEER CUSTOMERS. At the end of the long bar a milestone with a three-way signpost, labelled WEEK 12: END, NARROW OR KEEP.

BOTTOM STRIP, spanning the full width under both zones: one open blueprint document with three small icons on it (a gavel, a coin stack, a calendar with no digits), labelled BLUEPRINT: WHO DECIDES, WHO PAYS, WHEN TO REVIEW.

All documents and calendars are blank or show only wavy lines; no digits except in the labels.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: DECISION STUCK, BOARD OVERSIGHT, NEW KIND OF JUDGMENT, OPERATING ADVISER, SCARCE SKILL, SHARED SPECIALISTS, NO TIME TO EXECUTE, DEDICATED EXECUTION, SPECIALIST 6 WEEKS, PROGRAM LEADER 12 WEEKS, WEEK 6: NARROW TO 2 VOLUNTEER CUSTOMERS, WEEK 12: END, NARROW OR KEEP, BLUEPRINT: WHO DECIDES, WHO PAYS, WHEN TO REVIEW. Any other text is a defect.
alt: Four gaps are matched to four blueprints: a stuck decision to board oversight, a new kind of judgment to an operating adviser, a scarce skill to shared specialists and no time to execute to dedicated execution; a fictional shared sign-in pilot runs a specialist for six weeks and a program leader for twelve, narrows at week six to two volunteer customers, and at week twelve decides whether to end, narrow or keep the assignment; a blueprint document records who decides, who pays and when to review.
caption: Match the help to the missing capability, commit people for defined periods, and let each review decide the next step.
